newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs unchanged at 65.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs unchanged at 65.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs operating offshore Northwest Europe totalled 65 in the week ending June 18, unchanged from the previous week, consultants Arthur Andersen said.

There were 35 rigs drilling in British waters, up one on the week ending June 11, while the Norwegian sector was down one at 14. The Netherlands and Denmark were steady at 11 and four rigs respectively. Ireland was unchanged at one.

Arthur Andersen said in its weekly well report that the total number of exploration and appraisal wells throughout Northwest Europe to date in 1997 has reached 99. This compares with 81 spuds in the same period last year and represents a 23 percent increase.
